summary: Affiliate Partners backend tested end-to-end: 25/25 pytest tests PASS covering CRUD, RBAC (admin-only), validation (reserved prefix, invalid platform, duplicate code), auto-activation on contract signing, public tracking endpoints (track-click + lookup), stats (per-partner zero-state + global summary), and the two PDF download endpoints. All created test partners were soft-deleted via the API (status='terminated') for cleanup.

minor.issue: Successful create returns HTTP 200 instead of 201. response_model is set but no status_code=201 on the decorator. Cosmetic — tests still pass.
list_partners has no pagination/limit. For an admin tool that's currently fine, but will scale poorly past a few hundred partners.

`updates = {k: v for k, v in payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items() if v is not None}` silently drops fields set to None. That's intentional here but means clearing a field (e.g. iban=null, notes='') via PATCH is impossible. Worth noting.

When the code is unknown OR the partner is not active, both responses return `{ok: false}` with reason='code_not_active' only in the latter case. Unknown-code response has no `reason` field at all, which is inconsistent with the active-but-pending case. Frontend can't distinguish 'wrong code' vs 'not yet active'.

action_items: (Optional) Add status_code=201 to @router.post('/partners') for REST correctness.
(Optional) Add a `reason: 'unknown_code'` field to /affiliate/track-click when code does not exist, to mirror the 'code_not_active' branch.
(Optional) Consider pagination on GET /api/partners once partner count grows.
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint route ordering is OK: /partners/stats/summary is declared after /partners/{partner_id}/stats but FastAPI matches by segment count, so no collision.
Soft-delete via PATCH on the same id after DELETE is possible (delete just sets status='terminated'); make sure admin UI handles re-activation/idempotency.
lookup_code is unauthenticated and reveals partner_name + handle for active codes — acceptable for the signup flow but be aware of enumeration risk if codes are predictable.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 test partners during the run, all soft-deleted (status='terminated') after teardown. No hard-delete endpoint exists (by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_partners.py is reusable. Uses cousin.admin / cousin.commercial / cousin.technicien credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Module-scope teardown DELETEs every partner created during the run. Frontend (admin/partners.tsx) was NOT tested per request — please run UI tests if needed.
